AdrBaselineSourcePort.docs: Synchronous/blocking secondary port. Returned byte vectors are opaque file contents.

AdrBaselineStorePort.docs: Synchronous/blocking secondary port for filesystem-backed adapters; bytes is opaque file content.

CatalogPort.docs: Synchronous/blocking secondary port. CatalogError subsets are init={FileExists,SchemaInvalid,Port}, add={FileMissing,DuplicateEntry,AnchorNotFound,InvalidRole,ParseFragment,SchemaInvalid,Port}, import={FileMissing,DuplicateEntry,AnchorNotFound,SchemaInvalid,Port}, cite={FileMissing,AnchorNotFound,SchemaInvalid,Port}, and check={SchemaInvalid,Port}; no other variants are producible by those methods.

CatalogQueryService.docs: Read-only primary port implemented by CatalogInteractor; check produces only CatalogError::{SchemaInvalid,Port}.

CatalogService.docs: Command-side primary port implemented by CatalogInteractor. CatalogError subsets are init={FileExists,SchemaInvalid,Port}, add={FileMissing,DuplicateEntry,AnchorNotFound,InvalidRole,ParseFragment,SchemaInvalid,Port}, import={FileMissing,DuplicateEntry,AnchorNotFound,SchemaInvalid,Port}, and cite={FileMissing,AnchorNotFound,SchemaInvalid,Port}.

SelfBinaryTransplantPort.docs: Synchronous/blocking process and filesystem secondary port.

AdrBaselineSnapshotKind.docs: Usecase Dto for application-boundary data with no domain behavior.

CatalogError.docs: Catalog operation failure vocabulary; DraftIncomplete is removed because no operation constructs it, and the service and port contracts record their exact producible subsets.

CatalogInteractor.docs: Dependency-bearing implementation of CatalogService and CatalogQueryService.

CatalogTarget.docs: Owned catalogue location passed across primary ports; Dto is intentional because it carries boundary context without domain behavior.

ImplCatalogSignalReadError.docs: Failure produced while reading implementation-catalogue signals; FreeText carries unconstrained adapter diagnostics.

ImplPlanReadError.docs: Failure produced while reading implementation-plan task statuses; FreeText carries unconstrained adapter diagnostics.

PreReviewGateError.docs: Application-service error envelope that losslessly maps operation-specific task-contract, catalogue-signal, and implementation-plan read failures; diagnostic payloads use the domain FreeText newtype because their content is genuinely unstructured.

TaskContractReadError.docs: Failure produced while reading a task-contract document; FreeText carries unconstrained adapter diagnostics.
